# Libraries

```{r}
# load libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)
library(lubridate)
library(GGally)
library(ggcorrplot)

library(readxl)

theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 16))
```

# Data preparation

```{r}
# load environmental data (same as prepared by Ixak, Almudena and Leire)

amo <- read_excel(file.path("..","data","Procesos_ambientales_anchoa_LI.xlsx"), sheet="AMO")
ea <- read_excel(file.path("..","data","Procesos_ambientales_anchoa_LI.xlsx"), sheet="EA")
nao <- read_excel(file.path("..","data","Procesos_ambientales_anchoa_LI.xlsx"), sheet="NAO")
ui <- read_excel(file.path("..","data","Procesos_ambientales_anchoa_LI.xlsx"), sheet="UI")
turb <- read_excel(file.path("..","data","Procesos_ambientales_anchoa_LI.xlsx"), sheet="TURB")
wmld <- read_excel(file.path("..","data","Procesos_ambientales_anchoa_LI.xlsx"), sheet="WMLD")

# amo: monthly from 1870/01 to 2021/03
# ea: monthly from 1950/01 to 2021/12
# nao: monthly from 1950/01 to 2021/12
# ui: yearly from 1948 to 2021
# turb: monthly from 1948/01 to 2021/12
# wmld: yearly from 1986 to 2020

# add date, change column names and reorder columns

amo <- amo %>% 
  rename(year=AÑO, month=MES) %>% 
  mutate(date=as.Date(paste0(year, "-", month, "-01"), "%Y-%m-%d"),
         quarter=lubridate::quarter(date),
         semester=lubridate::semester(date)) %>% 
  select(year, month, quarter, semester, date, AMO)

ea <- ea %>% 
  rename(year=AÑO, month=MES) %>% 
  mutate(date=as.Date(paste0(year, "-", month, "-01"), "%Y-%m-%d"),
         quarter=lubridate::quarter(date),
         semester=lubridate::semester(date)) %>% 
  select(year, month, quarter, semester, date, EA)

nao <- nao %>% 
  rename(year=AÑO, month=MES) %>% 
  mutate(date=as.Date(paste0(year, "-", month, "-01"), "%Y-%m-%d"),
         quarter=lubridate::quarter(date),
         semester=lubridate::semester(date)) %>% 
  select(year, month, quarter, semester, date, NAO)

turb <- turb %>% 
  rename(year=AÑO, month=MES) %>% 
  mutate(date=as.Date(paste0(year, "-", month, "-01"), "%Y-%m-%d"),
         quarter=lubridate::quarter(date),
         semester=lubridate::semester(date)) %>% 
  select(year, month, quarter, semester, date, TURB)

ui <- ui %>% 
  rename(year=AÑO) %>% 
  mutate(month=1, date=as.Date(paste0(year, "-01-01"), "%Y-%m-%d"),
         quarter=lubridate::quarter(date),
         semester=lubridate::semester(date)) %>%  
  select(year, date, UI)

wmld <- wmld %>% 
  rename(year=AÑO,
         WMLD=WMLDmax) %>% 
  mutate(month=1, date=as.Date(paste0(year, "-01-01"), "%Y-%m-%d"),
         quarter=lubridate::quarter(date),
         semester=lubridate::semester(date)) %>% 
  select(year, date, WMLD)

```

# AMO

```{r}
p <- ggplot(amo, aes(date, AMO)) +
  geom_point()+
  geom_path()+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("AMO")
p

p <- ggplot(amo, aes(date, AMO)) +
  geom_point()+
  geom_path()+
  geom_smooth(method="loess", col=2, fill=2, alpha=0.4)+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("AMO")
p

p <- ggplot(amo, aes(date, AMO)) +
  geom_col(fill = "blue") +
  geom_smooth(method="loess", col="black", fill="black", alpha=0.4)+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("AMO")
p

p <- ggplot(amo, aes(date, AMO)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=0, ymax=AMO), fill = "blue") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0)+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("AMO")
p

p <- ggplot(amo, aes(date, AMO)) +
  geom_col(data = subset(amo, AMO <= 0), fill = "red") + 
  geom_col(data = subset(amo, AMO > 0), fill = "blue") +
  geom_smooth(method="loess", col="black", fill="black", alpha=0.4)+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("AMO")
p

p <- ggplot(subset(amo, year>1980), aes(date, AMO)) +
  geom_col(data = subset(amo, year>1980 & AMO <= 0), fill = "red") + 
  geom_col(data = subset(amo, year>1980 & AMO > 0), fill = "blue") +
  geom_smooth(method="loess", col="black", fill="black", alpha=0.4)+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("AMO")
p


# https://stackoverflow.com/questions/54687321/fill-area-above-and-below-horizontal-line-with-different-colors

m <- 0
# identify each run of points completely above (or below) the horizontal line as a new section
tmp <- amo %>%  
  mutate(x=1:nrow(amo)) %>% 
  select(x, AMO) %>% 
  arrange(x) %>%
  mutate(above.m = AMO >= m) %>%
  mutate(changed = is.na(lag(above.m)) | lag(above.m) != above.m) %>%
  mutate(section.id = cumsum(changed)) %>%
  select(-above.m, -changed)
# calculate the x-coordinate of the midpoint between adjacent sections (the y-coordinate would be m), & add this to the data frame
tmp <- rbind(
  tmp,
  tmp %>%
    group_by(section.id) %>%
    filter(x %in% c(min(x), max(x))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(mid.x = ifelse(section.id == 1 | 
                            section.id == lag(section.id), 
                          NA,
                          x - (x - lag(x)) / 
                            (AMO - lag(AMO)) * (AMO - m))) %>% 
    select(mid.x, AMO, section.id) %>%
    rename(x = mid.x) %>%
    mutate(AMO = m) %>%
    na.omit())
# transform back x into date
tmp <- tmp %>% 
  mutate(date=amo$date[x])

p <- ggplot(tmp, aes(date, AMO)) +      
  geom_ribbon(data = . %>% filter(AMO >= m),
              aes(ymin = m, ymax = AMO), 
              fill="dodgerblue") +
  geom_ribbon(data = . %>% filter(AMO <= m),
              aes(ymin = AMO, ymax = m), 
              fill = "firebrick1")+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("AMO")
p

# decompose time series

tmp <- amo
tmp <- ts(tmp$AMO, frequency=12, start=c(tmp$year[1], tmp$month[1]))
plot(decompose(tmp))

# decompose time series (from 1980 onwards)

tmp <- subset(amo, year>1980)
tmp <- ts(tmp$AMO, frequency=12, start=c(tmp$year[1], tmp$month[1]))
plot(decompose(tmp))

tmp0 <- decompose(tmp)
plot(tmp0$seasonal[1:12], type="o", pch=19, xlab="Month", ylab="Seasonal pattern")
abline(h=0, lty=2)

```

Compute 1 index per year

```{r}
amo.df <- amo %>%
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarise(AMO.mean=mean(AMO, na.rm=T),
            AMO.min=min(AMO, na.rm=T),
            AMO.max=max(AMO, na.rm=T),
            AMO.sd=sqrt(var(AMO, na.rm=T)),
            AMO.q1=mean(AMO[quarter==1], na.rm=T),
            AMO.q2=mean(AMO[quarter==2], na.rm=T),
            AMO.q3=mean(AMO[quarter==3], na.rm=T),
            AMO.q4=mean(AMO[quarter==4], na.rm=T),
            AMO.s1=mean(AMO[semester==1], na.rm=T),
            AMO.s2=mean(AMO[semester==2], na.rm=T)) %>% 
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=15}
ggpairs(amo.df[, -1]) 
```

```{r}
mat <- cor(amo.df[, -1], use="complete.obs") 
p.mat <- cor_pmat(amo.df[, -1])

ggcorrplot(mat, type = "lower", lab=T, p.mat = p.mat)
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(amo.df, aes(year, AMO.mean)) +
  geom_point()+
  geom_path()+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("AMO")
p

p <- ggplot(amo.df, aes(year, AMO.mean)) +
  geom_point()+
  geom_path()+
  geom_smooth(method="loess", col=2, fill=2, alpha=0.4)+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("AMO")
p

p <- ggplot(amo.df, aes(year, AMO.mean)) +
  geom_col(fill = "blue") +
  xlab("")+
  ylab("AMO")
p

p <- ggplot(amo.df, aes(year, AMO.mean)) +
  geom_col(data = subset(amo.df, AMO.mean <= 0), fill = "red") + 
  geom_col(data = subset(amo.df, AMO.mean > 0), fill = "blue") +
  xlab("")+
  ylab("AMO")
p

```

```{r}
  mutate(date=turb$date[x])

p <- ggplot(tmp, aes(date, TURB)) +      
  geom_ribbon(data = . %>% filter(TURB >= m),
              aes(ymin = m, ymax = TURB), 
              fill="dodgerblue") +
  geom_ribbon(data = . %>% filter(TURB <= m),
              aes(ymin = TURB, ymax = m), 
              fill = "firebrick1")+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("TURB")
p

# decompose time series

tmp <- turb
tmp <- ts(tmp$TURB, frequency=12, start=c(tmp$year[1], tmp$month[1]))
plot(decompose(tmp))

# decompose time series (from 1980 onwards)

tmp <- subset(turb, year>1980)
tmp <- ts(tmp$TURB, frequency=12, start=c(tmp$year[1], tmp$month[1]))
plot(decompose(tmp))

tmp0 <- decompose(tmp)
plot(tmp0$seasonal[1:12], type="o", pch=19, xlab="Month", ylab="Seasonal pattern")
abline(h=0, lty=2)

```

Compute 1 index per year

```{r}
turb.df <- turb %>%
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarise(TURB.mean=mean(TURB, na.rm=T),
            TURB.min=min(TURB, na.rm=T),
            TURB.max=max(TURB, na.rm=T),
            TURB.sd=sqrt(var(TURB, na.rm=T)),
            TURB.q1=mean(TURB[quarter==1], na.rm=T),
            TURB.q2=mean(TURB[quarter==2], na.rm=T),
            TURB.q3=mean(TURB[quarter==3], na.rm=T),
            TURB.q4=mean(TURB[quarter==4], na.rm=T),
            TURB.s1=mean(TURB[semester==1], na.rm=T),
            TURB.s2=mean(TURB[semester==2], na.rm=T)) %>% 
  as.data.frame()
```

# create a unique data frame

```{r}
df <- data.frame(year=1987:2021)

df <- left_join(df, amo.df)
df <- left_join(df, ea.df)
df <- left_join(df, nao.df)
df <- left_join(df, turb.df)
df <- left_join(df, ui)
df <- left_join(df, wmld)

write.csv(df, file=file.path("..","data","env_data.csv"), row.names=F)
```
